第005章 参加队内训练赛
球场上的队员们刚才也注意到了跟着保尔进入球场的黑发小子，莱恩听到呼喊后便跑向了场边。
王利在草坪上换上了背包里的球衣、球鞋，便上场了。
伍尔弗汉普顿青年队经常有申请来这里试训的年轻人，这些年轻人都会抓住一切机会表现自己，对于这些人来说，场上的几十分钟就是他们加入青年队的最后机会。
而其中能参加队内训练赛少之又少，一般来说，每个周末都会举行一场试训赛，每名前来试训的年轻人都能得到二十分钟到四十分钟的机会，他们需要做的就是在这段时间里尽量表现自己。
王利也是如此，就在昨天，他还想着在球场上演一出马拉多纳式的进球，来赢得教练的欣赏。
不过现在他却遇到麻烦了，在前五分钟，他都在徒劳的跑着，对于一个初来这里试训的少年，这些青年队的主力还是有些看不上眼的，所以也不会有人把球传给他。
现在场上的局面对王利来说并不乐观，甚至不如直接参加试训比赛，至少在那里他还能接到有表现自己传球能力的中场球员的传球。
“他好像遇到麻烦了。”保尔对老伍德说道。
“恩，那就看看这个小伙子怎么解决吧，如果连这都解决不了，他是不可能成为一个合格的职业球员的。”老伍德有些感慨的说道。
王利虽然很长时间都没接到球，不过他并没有灰心，球场上是靠实力说话的地方，他很相信自己的实力。
没过一会，机会就摆在了眼前。
查理.穆勒从刚才就一直注意着这个新上场的黑发小子。接到了门将的传球，他就沿着左边路带球向前推进。
‘就从你这里突破吧，顺便让你见识下狼队青年队的主力前锋的实力。’
他的带球速度很快，左右脚轮番的在滚动的足球上踩着单车，他的盘带水平确实不差。
不过这对王利来说，却完全没有任何作用。这种华而不实的运球方式并不能瞒过他的双眼，查理.穆勒刚想用一个漂亮的半转身甩过他，他左脚尖准确的踩踏在快速滚动的足球上，球马上就静止不动了。
而这时查理的身体已经在惯力的作用下前进了一米多。
“这小伙子的防守能力还不错啊，能这么轻松的从查理脚下断球，即使是查理有些大意，以他的抢断能力也足以胜任一名青年队替补后卫了。”老伍德看着保尔笑着说道，不过转头看了看王利那有些瘦弱的身体，他又叹气般的摇了摇头…
在这个球场上，可没有人把刚上场的王利当主角，就算在职业联赛也一样。机会都是靠自己争取的，如果你想获得尊重，便要在球场上证明自己的实力。
王利现在就有了一个好机会，他拿到球后，沿着边路快速的向前推进。

以他现在的速度，从中线带球直到底线只需要不到十秒的时间，在对方还没有反应过来时，他已经推进到了底线。
这时，对方已经分出两人包夹他，他们可不想让这个新人在这个球场嚣张。
看着上来的两人，王利嘴角露出一抹斜笑，右脚迅速的从球上方掠过后，回拉到身体后方，然后右脚把球向右一磕，球便向回滚去。
离底线稍远一些的黑大个反应了过来，扭动身体，朝着球跑去。
但现在球却并没有离开王利的身体，他双脚以一种不可思议的摆动形式迅速转过身体，左脚迅速把球回拉，黑大个身体就立刻被甩了过去，他可没有王利那般扭动的能力…
说时迟、那时快，这个过程也仅仅几秒而已，王利便带球出了两人的包围圈，进了大禁区。
这个时候他就有些范愁了，他并没有进行过战术的练习，也没有和别人配合过，这个时候就有些茫然不知所措，是直接射门，还是传球呢？
看着附近的队友，他并不知道该传给谁。
想法在脑中只一瞬间，他便决定射门。这个时候自己射门显然进球的概率更大一些，而且自己的射门水平也不差。
右脚迅速向上磕了下球，球弹起之后，左脚微抬小腿一摆，足球便径直朝着球门飞去。
可惜，打的有些歪了，擦球门而过。
王利叹了口气，便跑回了自己的位置，这次射门自己都觉得有些突然了，如果能射的正一些，肯定会得分的。
经过这次进攻，他已经有些融入了比赛，能够获得胜利，甚至自己能进个球，就是他的目的。
场上有些安静，大多人都盯着王利看了两眼，这个黑头发的小子刚才那脚射门实在太出人意料了，那种动作也能射门吗，就像杂技表演一样，他们对这个黑发小子有些改观了，至少他是有些才华的，即使刚才只是灵光一闪，那也很不错了。
场边的伍德盖特那张老迈的脸现在充满了笑容，有些兴奋的对旁边的保尔道：“这次我们可能捡到宝了，他的盘带速度很快，过人水平也很不错，而且能踢出那么有创意的射门，确实很有才华。”
创造力就是巨星和普通球员最大的区别，伍德盖特相当认可这一点，看到王利他就像看到了以后骄傲的资本，他多么希望以后能在老朋友面前说句：“看那XX就是我教出来的孩子。”然后享受别人崇拜的目光。
所以他现在越看场上奔跑的王利，就越是顺眼。
保尔同样的笑了笑，随即有些疑惑的道：“那么阿森纳青年队为什么拒绝了他呢？真是奇怪，会不会是他的传球有问题，你看他场上实在太独了，居然这么半天没传过一次球。”
老伍德同意般的点了点头，道：“或许吧，一会叫他下来，让他准备搬来伍尔弗汉普顿住吧，我会去找何塞，让他给这个小伙子一份青年队的合同。”
场上拼命奔跑的王利还不知道，他的表现已经打动了老伍德。

不过，现在他却有些尴尬，虽然他表现出来的水平很不错，但是拿到球之后便闷头往前带的做法使得其他人也不会传球给他，所以，他只能拼命奔跑来让自己更多的接触球，更多的表现。
‘我是该练习下传球了’，他想到。
其实，他能很准确的把球传到其他人脚下，但是他却不知道该传给谁，尤其是前场混乱的时候，他就更加的不知所措了。
这便是由于大局观的问题，他从来没有接受过正规的足球训练，球场上的感觉也不能经验照搬，不过王利相信自己在接受正规训练后，这方面肯定会有所加强的。
经过三十多分钟的对抗，比赛也终于结束了，走到场边后，保尔便告诉了王利他已经得到了老伍德认可的消息，并通知他尽快搬到伍尔弗汉普顿居住。

Chapter 005 Participating in team training matches
The players on the court had just noticed the black-haired boy who followed Paul into the court. Ryan heard the shout and ran to the sidelines.
Wang Li put on the jersey and sneakers in his backpack on the lawn and went on the field.
The Wolverhampton youth team often has young people who apply to try out here. These young people will seize every opportunity to express themselves. For these people, a few dozen minutes on the field is their last chance to join the youth team.
Very few of them can participate in team training matches. Generally speaking, a trial match is held every weekend. Every young person who comes for trial training can get a chance of twenty to forty minutes. All they need to do is to express themselves as much as possible during this time.
The same is true for Wang Li. Just yesterday, he was still thinking about performing a Maradona-style goal on the court to win the appreciation of the coach.
But now he is in trouble. In the first five minutes, he was running in vain. For a young boy who has just come here for trial training, the main players of these youth teams still look down upon him, so no one will pass the ball to him.
The current situation on the field is not optimistic for Wang Li. It is even better to directly participate in the trial match, where at least he can still receive passes from midfielders who can show his passing ability.
"He seems to be in trouble." Paul said to Old Wood.
"Well, let's see how this young man solves the problem. If he can't solve it, he won't be able to become a qualified professional player." Old Wood said with some emotion.
Although Wang Li didn't catch the ball for a long time, he was not discouraged. Strength speaks for itself on the court, and he believed in his own strength.
After a while, the opportunity appeared in front of me.
Charlie Mueller has been paying attention to this new black-haired boy since just now. After receiving the pass from the goalkeeper, he dribbled the ball forward along the left wing.
‘Let me break through from you. By the way, I will let you see the strength of the main forward of the Wolves youth team. ’
His dribbling speed is very fast, and his left and right feet take turns riding the bicycle on the rolling football. His dribbling level is indeed not bad.
But this had no effect at all on Wang Li. This flashy dribbling method could not hide from his eyes. Just as Charlie Muller was about to throw him away with a beautiful half-turn, his left toe accurately stepped on the fast-rolling football, and the ball immediately stopped.
At this time, Charlie's body had moved forward more than one meter under the action of inertia.
"This young man's defensive ability is not bad. He can steal the ball from Charlie so easily. Even if Charlie is a little careless, his stealing ability is enough to be a substitute defender for the youth team." Old Wood looked at Paul and said with a smile, but turned to look at Wang Li's thin body, and he sighed and shook his head...
On this court, no one regards Wang Li, who just came on the field, as the protagonist, even in the professional league. Opportunities are earned by yourself. If you want to gain respect, you have to prove your strength on the court.
Wang Li now had a good opportunity. After he got the ball, he quickly advanced along the wing.
At his current speed, it only takes less than ten seconds to dribble the ball from the center line to the baseline. Before the opponent can react, he has already advanced to the baseline.
At this time, the opponent had assigned two people to double-team him. They did not want this newcomer to be arrogant on this court.
Looking at the two people coming up, Wang Li showed a slanted smile. He quickly passed over the ball with his right foot, pulled it back behind his body, and then knocked the ball to the right with his right foot, and the ball rolled back.
The big black man who was a little further away from the baseline reacted, twisted his body, and ran towards the ball.
But now the ball has not left Wang Li's body. His feet are swinging in an incredible way.He quickly turned around and quickly pulled the ball back with his left foot. The big black body was immediately thrown away. He didn't have the ability to twist like Wang Li...
It was too late, but it was fast then. This process only took a few seconds. Wang Li dribbled the ball out of the circle surrounded by the two and entered the penalty area.
At this time, he was a little worried. He had not practiced tactics or cooperated with others. At this time, he was a little confused. Should he shoot directly or pass the ball?
Looking at his teammates nearby, he didn't know who to pass to.
The idea only came to his mind for a moment before he decided to shoot. At this time, the probability of scoring a goal is obviously higher when he shoots, and his shooting level is not bad either.
He quickly tapped the ball upwards with his right foot. After the ball bounced, he raised his left leg slightly and swung it, and the football flew straight towards the goal.
Unfortunately, the shot was a little crooked and missed the goal.
Wang Li sighed and ran back to his position. This time he felt that the shot was a bit sudden. If he could shoot more accurately, he would definitely score.
After this attack, he has somewhat integrated into the game. His goal is to win or even score a goal himself.
The court was a little quiet, and most people stared at Wang Li. The shot that the black-haired kid shot just now was so unexpected. Can he shoot with that kind of action? It was like an acrobatic performance. They had some changes in this black-haired kid. At least he had some talent. Even if it was just a flash of inspiration, it was pretty good.
Woodgate's old face on the sidelines was now full of smiles, and he said excitedly to Paul next to him: "We may have found a treasure this time. His dribbling speed is very fast, his dribbling skills are also very good, and he can kick such creative shots. He is really talented."
Creativity is the biggest difference between superstars and ordinary players. Woodgate quite recognizes this. Seeing Wang Li is like seeing the capital he will be proud of in the future. How he hopes to be able to say in front of old friends in the future: "Look at that XX is the child I taught." And then enjoy the admiration of others.
So the more he sees Wang Li running on the field, the more he likes it.
Paul smiled the same way, and then said with some doubts: "Then why did the Arsenal youth team reject him? It's really strange. Could it be that there is something wrong with his passing? You see, he is so alone on the field. He hasn't passed the ball once in such a long time."
Old Wood nodded in agreement and said: "Maybe, call him down later and let him prepare to move to Wolverhampton. I will go to Jose and ask him to give this young man a youth team contract."
Wang Li, who was running desperately on the court, didn't know it yet, but his performance had impressed Lao Wood.
However, now he is a little embarrassed. Although his performance is very good, his head-first approach after getting the ball prevents others from passing the ball to him. Therefore, he can only run hard to let himself touch the ball more and perform more.
'It's time for me to practice passing the ball,' he thought.
In fact, he can pass the ball to other people's feet very accurately, but he doesn't know who to pass it to, especially when the frontcourt is chaotic, he is even more at a loss.
This is due to the overall situation. He has never received formal football training, and his feelings on the court cannot be copied from experience. However, Wang Li believes that he will definitely improve in this aspect after receiving formal training.
After more than thirty minutes of confrontation, the game finally ended. After walking to the sidelines, Paul told Wang Li that he had been recognized by Old Wood and informed him to move to Wolverhampton as soon as possible.
